Description.OldValue: Set the value of this attribute to Yes to create a JSON/XML file without any content formatting (such as indents and new lines). The default value is No.
Description.NewValue: Set this attribute to Yes to generate the output (XML/JSON) without formatting, i.e., a plain file without indents or new lines. If not specified, the default is No (formatted output).

Description.OldValue: An expression that evaluates to Yes or No.
Description.NewValue: An expression that evaluates to Yes or No. Set to Yes for plain output (no formatting), or No for formatted output (with indents and new lines).
